'''Fabswa the Mutilated''' was a male [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] and the [[First Glorious Assassin of the Temple of the Beatific Razor]]. He had a comlink implanted in his head to receive instructions from his superiors. Fabswa's name most likely was because of a unique attribute he possessed
